title: CYBRIK org_node governed lifecycle transition v1 (D-1)
description: A governed status transition of an org_node (ADR-0007 D-1; 02 §1.2, §8). There is deliberately NO hard-delete: a node referenced by audit/history is NEVER row-deleted — the terminal state is 'archived'. operation enumerates ONLY the governed transitions (suspend / reactivate / archive / restore); a 'delete' operation is not expressible (enum), so a hard-delete of a referenced node is structurally impossible. Rollback of a reorg is a status transition ('restore'), not a row delete. archive MAY carry an optional backfill that reassigns live memberships/edges to a same-tenant successor node (reorg-churn handling, AC-11) — never a cross-tenant or external successor (INV-2/OD-1, enforced at runtime). Every transition is actor-attributed, reasoned, and audited. $id uses the RFC 2606 .example documentation domain. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). Accepted at Gate W2-G (Codex under Founder delegation, 2026-07-24).

tenant_id.description: The tenant of the node being transitioned. MUST equal the node's tenant_binding and actor.tenant_id (OD-1).

org_node_id.description: The node whose status is being transitioned.

operation.description: The governed lifecycle operation. 'suspend' (active->suspended), 'reactivate' (suspended->active), 'archive' (->archived, terminal), 'restore' (archived->active, a rollback as a status transition). There is deliberately NO 'delete': a referenced node is archived, never hard-deleted (D-1). A 'delete' value is not in the enum and is rejected.

resulting_status.description: The org_node status after this transition (active | suspended | archived). Never 'deleted' — that state does not exist.

actor.description: Who performed the governed transition. Model output can never populate an actor (ADR-0006).

backfill.description: Optional reassignment applied when archiving a node that still has live memberships/edges (reorg-churn, AC-11). References are backfilled onto a SAME-TENANT internal successor node — never dropped, never reassigned across tenants or to an external peer (runtime). Only meaningful with operation 'archive'.

successor_node_id.description: The same-tenant internal node that inherits the archived node's live references. MUST be in the same tenant and MUST NOT equal org_node_id (runtime).

reassign_memberships.description: Whether live memberships on the archived node are reassigned to the successor (true) or expired in place (false).

audit_ref.description: Reference to the append-only audit record for this governed transition (required — every lifecycle change is accountable).

allOf.$comment: backfill is only meaningful for an archive transition (a same-tenant successor inherits live references on archive).
